open.title: A college guide wants to profile the campus
open.body: Happiness is 80, which is the kind of number a college guide likes to print. The writer needs a room, a tour and, the guide is clear about this, lunch.

options.label: Host the writer: $276,000
options.detail: Four in a hundred more applicants for seven days, which takes in the next class.

open.title: Weekend review sessions
open.body: Classes are crowded, and crowded classes are most of what makes exams hard here. The faculty will run review sessions at the weekend, if someone pays for the rooms and the biscuits.

options.label: Pay for the sessions: $230,000
options.detail: Stress is 8 points lower for three days. More Academic seats would do it for good.
